cards.answer: Renekton is a close-range fighter/tank with an AD damage focus: his basic abilities deal physical damage and provide healing and a targeted stun, while Dominus adds nearby magic damage. His attacks build Fury that empowers abilities. Slice is a damaging dash that unlocks a second dash only if it hits an enemy.
cards.counterplay: Watch his Fury and keep distance to limit his healing and targeted stun; account for another dash if Slice hits an enemy.

cards.answer: Basic attacks and ability hits build Fury, which decays after inactivity; Fury generation increases below half health. At least 50 Fury makes the next eligible basic ability consume 50 Fury for an empowered effect. Slice is excluded from this empowerment, and empowered abilities do not generate Fury.
cards.counterplay: Check his Fury before trading, and allow extra distance when he can empower an ability; low health helps him rebuild Fury faster.

cards.answer: Cull the Meek deals physical damage around Renekton and heals him for each enemy hit, with more healing against champions. Its normal version also generates Fury. Fury empowerment increases its damage and healing.
cards.counterplay: Avoid staying beside him during trades, especially when he has Fury available for increased damage and healing.

cards.counterplay: Keep out of his attack reach when he threatens a stun, and avoid relying on a damage shield against his empowered attack.

cards.answer: Slice dashes through enemies, dealing physical damage; hitting an enemy briefly unlocks Dice, a second dash that also deals physical damage. Fury empowers Dice with additional damage and temporary armor reduction on enemies hit. Slice does not consume Fury for empowerment.
cards.counterplay: Track whether Slice hits any enemy before judging his remaining pursuit or escape, and be cautious about further physical damage after empowered Dice reduces your armor.

cards.answer: Dominus transforms Renekton into Tyrant form, granting bonus health, size and attack range, plus a larger Cull the Meek area. It grants Fury on activation and continually generates more during the form, up to a cap. Its aura continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies.
cards.counterplay: Reassess close trades when he activates Dominus; create distance from its aura and account for his extra health, reach and renewed Fury.
